findings: MainView markup now whole-read: all 1761 lines, complementing prior full XML traversal.

Find pane exposes a Use Regular Expressions toggle with no binding, name or event; reviewed FindWithinSearchResults implementation always uses case-insensitive string Contains. Thus the visible regex option is not connected to search semantics in these sources.

Result checkboxes respect busy/deleted state and allow locked members only when every member is locked. AreAllFilesLocked property is misleadingly named (returns Any unlocked), but XAML inverts it, yielding the intended all-locked predicate.
Context menu automatic marking passes selected items; lock/unlock visibility follows selected representative while command predicates inspect selected groups. No runtime interaction executed.

Main result text columns generally do not explicitly set IsReadOnly except Group; backing properties are read-only, so editing behavior depends on DataGrid binding/runtime. No source mutation via cells claimed.

Status cancellation is shown via OperationCanBeCanceled and progress visibility via IsBusy; zero progress uses indeterminate display. Preview visibility only hides its container and does not gate decoding upstream.
